tooling.message:
fix(renovate): move every pin of the tooling commit in one pull request

## Intent

Repos pin the tooling commit not only in action refs and the npm dependency, which Renovate moves, but also as plain strings: tooling-ref in workflows and TOOLING_REF in the hooks. Tests require all of them to be the same commit, so a partial bump turns CI red, and the change-scope pull requests kept falling into conflict. Teach Renovate to move all of them at once, in the org's shared preset, not in a personal one.

## Key changes

- Two regex custom managers read tooling-ref and TOOLING_REF as the git reference lernapps/tooling at main.
- The group lernapps building blocks now matches all @lernapps/* packages, so the tooling and app-templates move in the same pull request as the actions, the scope workflow and the plain strings. This supersedes tooling#39.
- A test runs the match patterns as Renovate does against snippets of the real workflows and hooks, and checks the group.
